author: Karen McGuire
text: I put mine on my back just in front of my arm so follow top of arm to back. Always stays on. Never stays on if I put it on my arm.

text: I have put them on my thigh near my pocket area. They stay on really well and I don't get compression lows. However, the readings are not the same. I think my number is tend to run a little lower.
